nameOrigin: to rest on a surface of liquid
small mammal with a long body

pokedexEntries.di: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

pokedexEntries.pt: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

pokedexEntries.hgss: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

pokedexEntries.la: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
